page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance built on KVM hypervisor architecture. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU clocked at 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. It includes 35 MB of L3 cache, AVX and AVX-512 instruction set support, and dedicated CPU allocation. The instance features 64.0 GB of memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Network connectivity is rated at a 3 Gbps baseline bandwidth. It contains no bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations highlight a distinct performance profile defined by single-thread limitations alongside stable multi-core throughput. Single-core processing score in Geekbench (925.0) and single-threaded gzip compression performance place in the lower tier. However, multi-core benchmarks show average results, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 5662.0, PassMark CPU score of 13262.56, and stress-ng multi-core result of 11751.7. Memory bandwidth tests yield uncached throughput rates of 77.7 GB/sec for reads and 59.92 GB/sec for writes. The platform delivers 11.29 million Redis SET operations per second and static web serving throughput of 7.81 GB/sec.

From a hardware density perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge offers moderate resource capacity suited for horizontally scalable applications that rely on parallel core usage rather than peak per-core speed. With no local SSD storage included, workloads require attached block storage services. Recommended deployment profiles include general web application servers, Redis caching clusters, microservice backends, and moderate multi-threaded software compilation tasks.
